correctness.rationale: A complete recursion over intersection matrices generates every isomorphism class (deletion of one element is its inverse), with exact row/column permutation canonicalization. Two-variable counting equivalence is characterized by stable, jointly named refinement colors for the full joint E/F 2-type. The exact no-dependencies program enumerates 1,4,10,33,91,298,910,3017 isomorphism types and 1,4,10,33,91,298,910,3016 C2-classes; it identifies precisely the C8 / 2C4 pair. Both witnesses are proven nonisomorphic by components and C2-equivalent by uniform relation counts. A separate labeled-partition test checks orders ≤5; external sequence A007716 corroborates the full isomorphism totals. No unproved infinity assertion is made.

value.rationale: Two equivalence relations and their incidence representation form a mathematically canonical finite-model class. Determining the first cardinality at which C2 loses the isomorphism property and the exact complete first failure layer is a natural invariant of the logic, not an arbitrary sliced parameter. The witness pinpoints failure of global connectivity reconstruction even though all local equivalence-class intersections look alike. Known total enumeration of matrix orbits does not determine the quotient size or unique exceptional class. The result is self-contained and reproducible, with modest but substantive foundational value.
